name: baseball-field-smile-girl
image_purpose: Sports-event social portrait and fan lifestyle content

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic candid sports-event portrait of an approved adult woman enjoying a night baseball game from the stadium seats.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, warm natural skin, and a radiant smile looking back over her shoulder. She wears the reference's blue-and-white baseball cap with visible team-style mark, white fitted sleeveless crop top, baggy green-brown camouflage cargo pants, black-and-white high-top basketball sneakers, and minimal jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium-full shot showing her seated sideways in a yellow stadium seat with knees comfortably raised and arms resting on them. Include the professional stadium, blurred spectators, floodlights, green field, and authentic event clutter.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright stadium floodlights with balanced fill on the subject, crisp night contrast, realistic stadium reflections, lively crowd energy, and natural candid smartphone feel.
prompt.technical_specs: High-shutter-speed handheld smartphone look, shallow but believable background separation, sharp face and clothing texture, realistic hair and skin, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic candid vertical 9:16 sports-event portrait of one approved adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, warm natural skin, and a radiant smile looking back over her shoulder. She wears the reference's blue-and-white baseball cap with its visible team-style mark, white fitted sleeveless crop top, baggy green-brown camouflage cargo pants, black-and-white high-top basketball sneakers, and minimal jewelry. She sits sideways in a yellow stadium seat with knees comfortably raised and arms resting on them. Professional baseball stadium at night, blurred spectators, bright floodlights, glimpse of green field, authentic event clutter, balanced fill light, high shutter speed, sharp face and fabric texture, realistic candid smartphone finish.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, childlike appearance, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, invented team logos, random text, watermark, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve approved adult identity, exact outfit, visible cap mark, stadium context, seated pose, and event lighting. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent team marks or text.
